evidence.note: After baseline SANA, analyzes degree distributions (diagnostic) then pivots to basin hopping, a second binary (sana2), and adaptive/cold temperature schedules — materially different tactics rather than reruns.
Switches to an entirely different algorithm (Iterated Local Search, ils.py) when SA plateaus, showing willingness to change the core method.

Introduces reference/perfect-alignment seeding (anchor_setup, low-degree anchors, run-from-perfect-with-NC-weight) specifically to raise NC on Y2KR-SC — a diagnosis-driven pivot tied to the metric that lags.

Combines complementary signals for the two-constraint problem: greedy NC injection with S3 floor (136,191), weighted SA S3+NC (148), and a hard NC constraint (204-208) — deliberate targeting of NC while protecting S3.
For DM-HS (S3-only) adds degree-matched init and a new 3-cycle move — local topological search aimed at the S3 shortfall, distinct from the NC-oriented work.
Saves fallback/best alignment and reheats from best, abandoning failing runs (76,80,117,119) without discarding accumulated gains.

reasoning: The agent repeatedly abandons plateaued approaches and pivots to materially different tactics tied to the observed shortfall, treating the S3-only (DM-HS) and S3+NC (Y2KR-SC) constraint sets differently: NC lag → reference seeding and NC injection; S3 lag → topological moves, weighted objective, degree init. It combines complementary signals (weighted SA, hard NC constraint) and preserves best-so-far results while killing dead runs, matching the level-8 to level-10 anchors. I place it at 9 rather than 10 because the index shows some prolonged grinding of wait/check cycles and I cannot confirm from prose how quickly hypotheses were formed and dead ends dropped.
